people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
translations.bsb: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
translations.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
translations.asv: And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians; and he was mighty in his words and works.
